about_short_description.short_description: Prodigy.Fi is a decentralized platform dedicated to facilitating income generation through on-chain dual investment trading strategies.

product.name: Dual Investment Vaults
product.description: Smart contract-based vaults allowing users to earn fixed yields by subscribing to buy low or sell high strategies on cryptocurrency assets with predefined strike prices and expirations.

product.name: Vault Creation Service
product.description: A service enabling liquidity providers to create customized Dual Investment vaults by setting parameters like asset pairs, strike prices, yields, and expiration dates to offer investment opportunities to subscribers.

product.name: Vault Subscription Service
product.description: A service allowing users to subscribe to existing Dual Investment vaults by depositing assets to earn fixed yields and participate in buy low or sell high strategies based on vault parameters.
